history.content: Design a single-floor home, plot 40 feet wide and 40 feet long, south-facing entrance. Exactly 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms total. Attach one bathroom each to bedrooms [1]; all remaining bathrooms are common. Include living room, separate dining room, kitchen. No parking. Keep hallway space compact, bedrooms balanced, and kitchen next to dining. Record these requirements and prepare to generate.

Great, I’ve recorded a 40 × 40 ft plot with a south‑facing entrance, a single floor, 2 bedrooms (with bedroom 1 having its own attached bathroom) and a total of 2 bathrooms, plus a living room, kitchen, dining room and a compact hallway. You’ve also noted no parking and that the kitchen should sit next to the dining room.

When you’re ready, just click “Generate 3D home,” and let me know if you’d like any final tweaks before we proceed.
